stories.headline: SoftBank sweep the Japan Series in four games
stories.summary: The 77th Japan Series brought together the Central League's Yokohama DeNA BayStars and the Pacific League's Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks. Neither side had lost a game on the way to the final. The Hawks then swept the series in four games to take their 13th Japan Series championship.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms raises India's largest ever IPO
stories.summary: Jio Platforms has raised US$3.2 billion in what is described as India's largest-ever initial public offering. Bids of about $77 billion came in, making it the country's most-subscribed IPO. The issue was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening, ahead of the company's stock-market debut in Mumbai.

stories.headline: The Bank of Canada raises its policy rate
stories.summary: The Bank of Canada has raised its policy interest rate by 25 basis points, taking it to 2.5%. That is the bank's first increase since July 2023. It cited persistent inflation, driven partly by higher oil and gasoline prices.

stories.headline: Fire salamanders glow under ultraviolet light
stories.summary: New research has found that fire salamanders fluoresce under ultraviolet light, most strongly on the yellow underside of the body and along the sides. The glow was traced mainly to glands in the skin and the substances those glands release. Those secretions keep glowing for more than 24 hours after they leave the animal.
